images.alt: PaperFigure — source-grounded research figures, editable by design. Gallery of actual CLIP, Agentless and MAE Office renders; SVG, PPTX and PDF examples below.
CLIP: paired image and text alignment with a symmetric contrastive objective, followed by zero-shot classification using the same encoders.
Agentless: repository-to-edit-location localization funnel, focused context for local Search/Replace, and candidate patch selection.
MAE: four visible patches enter the encoder, twelve learned mask tokens join afterward, and a lightweight decoder predicts all patches with masked-only MSE.
